title: hauksbee-ci spec
description: A hauksbee-ci TOML spec: one headless board+firmware co-simulation and the assertions that must hold for the build to pass. Hand-written from crates/hauksbee-ci/src/spec.rs and scenarios.rs (schemars is not a workspace dependency); the Rust structs use serde deny_unknown_fields, mirrored here as additionalProperties:false. Keep in sync with spec.rs.

name.description: Human-readable name for the check (appears in reports). Default "hauksbee-ci".

board.description: Path to the board file, relative to this spec file's directory (.kicad_pcb, .kicad_sch, .net, .brd, .d356).

firmware.description: Optional firmware ELF/hex, relative to this spec file's directory.

mcu.description: Optional MCU-kind hint (informational; the binder detects the MCU).

frame_ms.description: Co-sim frame cadence in milliseconds (how often nets are sampled). Default 1.

ambient_c.description: Ambient temperature (C) for the steady-state junction-temperature estimate (max_temp assertions). Default 25.

suppress_rail.description: Supply nets whose binder auto-rail is removed, so they are fed only through on-board components (e.g. a rail behind a sense shunt).

supply.description: Power-supply legs to attach to named supply nets.

net_drive.description: Nets forced to a fixed voltage for the whole run (external stimulus, register bits, strapping). Stamped as an ideal source.

peripheral.description: Peripherals attached to the board for this run (buttons, pots, encoders, stimulus, I2C/SPI slaves, VCD sinks).

override.description: Component value overrides applied before binding (e.g. swap a wrong resistor value for the documented repair).

fuzz.description: Initial-state fuzzing: run the sim under several random register/undefined-state seeds. An assertion must hold across ALL seeds.

nets.description: Nets whose initial logic state is randomized per seed. When empty, every net_drive net is fuzzed.

levels.description: The two voltage levels a fuzzed net is strapped between (default 0/5 V).

scenario.description: Transient scenarios: dynamic load profiles attached to parts (drawn as current sinks on supply nets), exercising inrush / sag / brownout that DC cannot see.

id.description: Stable id, referenced by rail_window / protection_trip assertions.

part.description: The part the load attaches to (reference designator, e.g. "U5").

profile.description: The named load profile (built-in id, e.g. "esp32_boot_wifi", or one defined in [[profile]]).

supply_net.description: The supply net the load current is drawn from. If omitted, inferred from the part's power pins.

start_ms.description: When the profile's activity begins (ms into the run). Default 0.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for profile jitter. Default 0.

profile.description: Inline (spec-local) load-profile definitions, referenced by a scenario's profile field.

decoupling.description: Opt-in capacitor parasitics (ESR/ESL) for this run. Off by default.

parasitics.description: Turn on ESR/ESL on the board's decoupling capacitors using package/dielectric defaults.

ac.description: Small-signal AC analysis: a frequency sweep run once on the biased circuit, feeding phase_margin / ac_gain assertions.

sensor.description: Declarative I2C/SPI sensors attached to the co-sim for this run.

id.description: Stable identifier (used in error messages and state assertions).

spec.description: Inline sensor spec string (the [sensor] TOML block verbatim). Mutually exclusive with spec_file.

spec_file.description: Path to a .toml file containing the [sensor] block, relative to this spec file. Mutually exclusive with spec.

inputs.description: Input overrides: map from input name to value.

controller.description: Optional SPI controller name (e.g. "spi2") for multi-bus MCUs.

assert.description: The assertions, all of which must pass. A spec with no [[assert]] blocks is rejected (it would pass vacuously).

protection_trip_a.description: BMS over-current protection trip threshold (A). Present = protected pack.

protection_delay_ms.description: Sustained time above the trip threshold before the cutoff latches (ms). Default 0.

protection_reset_a.description: Current the load must fall below to re-arm the cutoff (A). Default: trip.

id.description: Stable id, used by events / live control / state assertions.

net.description: Attach by net name (or use ref+pin).

ref.description: Connector reference designator (e.g. "J1") for ref+pin attachment.

pin.description: Pin/pad number on the connector for ref+pin attachment.

to.description: Second terminal net for a button / toggle (default GND).

wiper.description: Potentiometer wiper net (net= is the wiper if omitted).

bounce_ms.description: Contact-bounce duration (ms) for a pushbutton; 0/absent disables it.

initial.description: Initial state: button pressed / toggle closed / control position.

r_total.description: Total track resistance for a potentiometer (ohms).

vhigh.description: High-level voltage for an encoder / digital control output.

cs_net.description: Chip-select net for a SPI slave; enables exact CS-edge framing when it resolves to an MCU GPIO.

vcd_path.description: Path to write the VCD file (relative to the spec dir).

event.description: Timeline of events applied during the run: at t_ms, set the peripheral to value.

kind.description: Assertion kind. voltage: net stays in [min,max]. uart: output contains/matches. toggle: net toggles at freq_hz or >= min_toggles. no_faults: no stress faults raised. max_current: I(ref) <= amps. max_temp: Tj(ref) <= celsius (or device max). peripheral: peripheral state check. rail_window: rail dip/recovery bounds over a scenario window. protection_trip: battery protection trips (or must not). boot-coverage: a control net is driven to min volts within deadline_ms of reset. phase_margin / ac_gain: small-signal loop checks (need an [ac] block).

name.description: Optional label (defaults to a generated description).

net.description: Target net (voltage / toggle / rail_window / boot-coverage / phase_margin / ac_gain).

min.description: Lower bound (volts / dB / degrees / peripheral field).

after_ms.description: Only sample at/after this time (ms) — lets the rail settle first. Not supported on toggle.

contains.description: uart: substring the UART output must contain.

matches.description: uart: regex the UART output must match.

mcu.description: uart: which MCU's UART (by reference). Defaults to all MCUs concatenated.

freq_hz.description: toggle: expected toggle frequency (Hz); ac_gain: measurement frequency.

min_toggles.description: toggle: minimum toggle count over the run (alternative to freq_hz).

ref.description: max_current / max_temp: the component to check.

celsius.description: max_temp: ceiling in C. When omitted, the device's own max junction temperature is used.

id.description: peripheral: the peripheral id to check.

bytes.description: peripheral: EEPROM byte sequence (hex string, e.g. "48 69" or "4869") that must appear in memory.

field.description: peripheral: a state field that must lie in [min, max] (e.g. "transitions", "temp_c").

scenario.description: Scope the assertion to one scenario's window by its id. Unset = whole run.

dip_below.description: rail_window: the rail is 'dipped' while below this voltage.

for_max_ms.description: rail_window: total time below dip_below must not exceed this (ms).

recover_to.description: rail_window: the voltage the rail must climb back to for 'recovered'.

recover_within_ms.description: rail_window: must recover within this many ms of first dipping. Needs dip_below and recover_to.

supply_net.description: protection_trip: the supply net whose battery protection is checked.

expect_trip.description: protection_trip: whether a trip is expected (true) or must NOT occur (false).

deadline_ms.description: boot-coverage: the boot deadline (ms after reset).
